items.title: Dave Bailey and John McNeil Interview, 1959-10-25
items.q: I know he was a nice little trumpet player, Wesley Dimes. Yeah, I remember him.

ctx.x: He's been dead for quite a while. I wrote it all down from the grave, you know. All that.
He'd be a nice kid. I know he was a nice little trumpet player, Wesley Dimes. Yeah, I remember him.
I guess Eddie Morris told me about it, you know. He used to be with you, huh, in that band. Yeah.
